'''Caf creamer''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dairy product]]. The [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]] was well-regarded throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] and gourmet [[Caf/Legends|caf]] [[Cream/Legends|creamer]] it produced using the [[Milk/Legends|milk]] of a [[Species/Legends|creature]] called the [[lactil]].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> The creamer shared a name with caf, a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] beverage.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|104|Caf}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Caf creamer was mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[2014]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' module [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Non-dairy creamer|coffee creamer]] is used to sweaten [[Wikipedia:Coffee|coffee]] as a substitute for [[Wikipedia:Milk|milk]] or [[Wikipedia:Cream|cream]]. It contains lower levels of [[Wikipedia:Lactic acid|lactic acid]].<ref name="FDA">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/problems-digesting-dairy-products|text=Problems Digesting Dairy Products?|work=[[Wikipedia:Food and Drug Administration|Food and Drug Administration]]|archivedate=20191215144620}}</ref>
